name: IC 831, iPTF14atg field (Hubble)
blurb: IC 831, an elliptical galaxy that hosted the supernova iPTF14atg, seen by Hubble.
label: iptf14atg-hubble
story: In this galaxy, the faint Type Ia supernova iPTF14atg gave off a strong early pulse of light in its first days, which astronomers traced to the blast striking a companion star. Hubble returned to the site long after the supernova had faded.

claims.text: iPTF14atg appeared in the galaxy IC 831, which is classified as an elliptical (or S0) galaxy
iPTF14atg is a subluminous Type Ia supernova that showed a strong ultraviolet pulse early on, attributed to the ejecta colliding with a companion star
